title: Final State Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the state |psi(t) in terms of the |s_z eigenstates.

title: Expectation Value s_z
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expectation value for s_z as a function of time.

title: Expectation Value s_y
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify that the expectation value for s_y is zero.

title: Expectation Value s_x
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expectation value for s_x as a function of time.

title: Hamiltonian Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state the Hamiltonian of the system.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the expectation values.

title: Initial Condition Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the initial condition to find coefficients c_1 and c_2.
